invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破73200（基于日线支撑和ATR），或融资费率Z-score回落至0%以下（风险缓解但需监控）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 73200 (based on daily support and ATR), or funding Z-score falls below 0% (risk eases but monitor).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.099（基于ATR 0.0012和支撑），或融资费率Z-score升至120%以上（多头过度拥挤）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.099 (based on ATR 0.0012 and support), or funding Z-score rises above 120% (overly crowded longs).
